evidence: issue #367 real-Jul native gRPC passthrough (h2c, trailers, grpc-status) E2E
categories.rationale: FastCGI is strict-valid, now with literal fastcgi_param entries; uwsgi_pass translates the same way (no uwsgi_param equivalent, stays blocking). grpc_pass maps grpc://->h2c and grpcs://->HTTP/2+TLS onto native gRPC passthrough, reusing a cleartext http2 listen token as h2c=true. NGINX stream has a bounded subset (#426): direct/named-upstream TCP/UDP targets, timeouts, outbound PROXY protocol, and server_name+ssl_preread SNI routing merged into one listener. Stream TLS termination, inbound PROXY protocol, udp+proxy_protocol, unrecognized listen options, ssl_preread maps, Lua, njs, and mail stay blocking. #367 proves the stream translation, a gRPC unary call surviving passthrough with trailers/grpc-status, and real FastCGI/uWSGI backends receiving translated params over the wire.
categories.revisit_trigger: Existing product protocol E2E remains authoritative for runtime capability itself; H2/H3 and WebSocket migration replay would need a broader migration-corpus lane, not a #367-specific gap.
